{{Quote|Jedi Master Prokreisha, who stopped the ''rust plague'' and fought at Malastare.|[[Oniye Namada]] in her [[I-1807-VAK|report]]|<ref name="TTF2" />}}
'''Prokreisha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] who was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. During his service to the Order he ended the [[Rust plague]] and fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. In recognition of his actions, the people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]] erected a statue of Prokreisha's in a public square in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vaklin Zenith]]. The statue showed him holding up a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] while wearing [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] and a moustache. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during an [[Vaklin insurgency|insurgency]] on [[Vaklin]], led by three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] against the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the dissolution of the Jedi Order, Prokreisha's statue was destroyed. Prior to its destruction, [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Oniye Namada]] asked a [[Unidentified Zabrak civilian|citizen]] of Vaklin to identify the statue, and they responded that it showed a war hero. Its destruction was part of an attempt to wipe out all memory of the Order's existence on Vaklin, and reduce public support for the Insurgency. Namada later mentioned Prokreisha in a report she wrote on the Vaklin insurgency, titled [[I-1807-VAK]].<ref name="TTF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prokreisha was first mentioned in [[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 2]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Alexander Freed]] and released in [[2013]] and part of the [[Purge (comic book)|''Star Wars: Purge'']] series. The book does not make clear what era he lived in or what their [[Species/Legends|species]].
